insert.column: SELECT lo.account_no AS loan, ag.name AS agencia, pr.name AS producto, '' AS cartera, cl.external_id AS codigo_cliente, cl.display_name AS nombre_cliente, CONCAT(gu.firstname, ' ', gu.lastname) AS usuario_registro, CONCAT(addBy.firstname, ' ', addBy.lastname) AS asesor_ci, CONCAT(agl.firstname, ' ', agl.lastname) AS lider_agencia, DATE(pg.created_at) AS fecha_ingreso, '' AS fecha_analisis, DATE(lo.rejectedon_date) AS fecha_rechazo, cvr.code_value AS motivo_rechazo, pl.comments AS comentario_rechazo, CASE pl.from_status WHEN 100 THEN 'Pendiente' WHEN 300 THEN 'Rechazado' WHEN 400 THEN 'Revisión de lista negra completada' WHEN 500 THEN 'Rechazado por lista negra' WHEN 600 THEN 'Consulta a buró completada' WHEN 700 THEN 'Revisión de políticas duras completada' WHEN 701 THEN 'Consentimiento agregado' WHEN 800 THEN 'Tiempo expirado' WHEN 900 THEN 'Completado' WHEN 902 THEN 'Pendiente de aprobación (Líder de agencia)' WHEN 903 THEN 'Solicitud de actualización de pre-calificación' WHEN 904 THEN 'Pendiente de aprobación con excepciones (Líder de agencia)' WHEN 905 THEN 'Aprobado con excepciones (Líder de agencia)' WHEN 1001 THEN 'Pendiente de aprobación (Unidad de análisis)' WHEN 1002 THEN 'Pendiente de aprobación con excepciones (Unidad de análisis)' WHEN 1003 THEN 'Pendiente de aprobación (Comité D)' WHEN 1004 THEN 'Pendiente de aprobación (Comité C)' WHEN 1005 THEN 'Pendiente de aprobación (Comité B)' WHEN 1006 THEN 'Pendiente de aprobación (Comité A)' ELSE 'Inválido' END AS etapa_rechazo, CONCAT(rej.firstname, ' ', rej.lastname) AS persona_que_rechazo, lo.principal_amount AS monto, lo.term_frequency AS plazo, lo.annual_nominal_interest_rate AS tasa, lc.description AS garantia FROM m_loan lo LEFT JOIN m_loan_collateral lc ON lc.loan_id = lo.id LEFT JOIN m_client cl ON cl.id = lo.client_id LEFT JOIN m_prequalification_group pg ON pg.id = lo.prequalification_id LEFT JOIN m_product_loan pr ON pr.id = lo.product_id LEFT JOIN m_agency ag ON ag.id = pg.agency_id LEFT JOIN m_appuser agl ON agl.id = ag.responsible_user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p1.* FROM m_prequalification_status_log p1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT prequalification_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM m_prequalification_status_log GROUP BY prequalification_id ) p2 ON p1.prequalification_id = p2.prequalification_id AND p1.id = p2.max_id ) pl ON pl.prequalification_id = lo.prequalification_id LEFT JOIN m_code_value cvr ON pl.reason_code_id = cvr.id LEFT JOIN m_appuser gu ON gu.id = lo.created_by LEFT JOIN m_appuser addBy ON addBy.id = pg.added_by LEFT JOIN m_appuser rej ON rej.id = pl.updatedby_id WHERE lo.loan_status_id = 500 AND DATE(lo.rejectedon_date) >= '${startDate}' AND DATE(lo.rejectedon_date) <= '${endDate}'

INSERT INTO stretchy_report_parameter (report_id, parameter_id, report_parameter_name) SELECT r.id, p.id, 'startDate' FROM stretchy_report r JOIN stretchy_parameter p ON p.parameter_name = 'startDateSelect' WHERE r.report_name = 'Rejected Loans Report';
INSERT INTO stretchy_report_parameter (report_id, parameter_id, report_parameter_name) SELECT r.id, p.id, 'endDate' FROM stretchy_report r JOIN stretchy_parameter p ON p.parameter_name = 'endDateSelect' WHERE r.report_name = 'Rejected Loans Report';
